title: Employee Relations Business Partner
description:
The Employee Relations Business Partner (ERBP) serves as the dedicated employee relations consultant for an assigned portfolio of regions, partnering closely with field leaders and team members on the full range of employee relations matters. This role manages employee relations concerns, workplace investigations, grievances, complaints, whistleblower reports, and recurring trends within assigned regions, and serves as the primary point of contact for leaders and employees seeking guidance on employee relations issues. The ERBP operates as a consultant-style business partner — providing sound judgment, risk assessment, and recommended courses of action — rather than as a decision-making authority over personnel outcomes. This role also functions as a liaison between the field and HR Legal/Compliance, helping ensure consistent, legally sound practice across the organization. The primary deliverables for this position are timely and objective resolution of employee relations matters, identification of actionable trends, mitigation of organizational risk, and delivery of HR services grounded in partnership, discretion, and sound judgment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary employee relations business partner and point of contact for leaders and team members within an assigned group of regions.
  • Manage the full spectrum of employee relations matters, including concerns, workplace investigations, grievances, complaints, and recurring trends.
  • Be readily available to leaders and team members to discuss employee relations concerns via phone, Teams, email, or in person, responding within established service-level expectations.
  • Serve as a primary intake point for whistleblower complaints, ensuring appropriate documentation, escalation, and follow-through to resolution.
  • Conduct thorough, objective, and well-documented investigations into workplace complaints, including allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, and policy violations.
  • Identify and analyze employee relations trends across assigned regions and proactively report findings and recommendations to HR leadership.
  • Act as the HR liaison to Legal and Compliance on employment law matters, helping ensure consistent application of policy and legally sound decision-making across the field.
  • Participate actively in high-level, sensitive conversations with leaders and employees, exercising independent, sound judgment while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
  • Represent Human Resources in frequent virtual meetings, engaging as a credible, active participant in discussions with field and senior leadership.
  • Think critically to evaluate competing facts and considerations in employee relations matters and recommend appropriate, risk-informed resolutions.
  • Partner with the Senior Employee Relations Business Partner and broader HR team to calibrate practices and ensure consistency of employee relations decisions across all regions.
  • Coach and advise managers on progressive discipline, performance documentation, and legally compliant management practices.
  • Maintain current working knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local employment laws affecting assigned regions.
  • Escalate high-risk or high-exposure matters to the Senior Employee Relations Business Partner, HR leadership, or Legal as appropriate.
  • Partner with Legal on responses to agency charges (e.g., EEOC), unemployment claims, and other employment-related inquiries as needed.
  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready case documentation and employee relations records in accordance with company recordkeeping standards.
  • Support the development and periodic update of HR policies in partnership with HR leadership and Legal.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:

  • Ability to exercise independent, sound judgment when navigating ambiguous or sensitive employee relations situations.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to weigh competing facts and business considerations.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to deliver difficult messages clearly and professionally.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to build trust so leaders and employees feel comfortable raising concerns without fear of negative recourse.
  • Demonstrated discretion and the ability to maintain confidentiality in highly sensitive matters.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent, sensitive matters across multiple regions with sound prioritization.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-visibility virtual meeting environment, including frequent camera-on participation in leadership discussions.
  • Ability to work independently as a consultant-style partner, influencing outcomes without direct management authority over field personnel.
  • Working knowledge of investigation methodology, evidence-gathering, and documentation standards.
  • Highly computer literate, with comfort using Workday, MS Office applications, and virtual meeting platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams).
  • Effective at building relationships across field and corporate teams.

Education and/or Experience:

  • Degree of certificate in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, including 2–3+ years focused specifically on employee relations and/or workplace investigations.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local employment law (e.g., Title VII, ADA, FMLA, FLSA) and related best practices.
  • Experience partnering directly with Legal or Compliance on employment matters strongly preferred.
  • Multi-state or multi-region field HR experience preferred.
  • PHR/SPHR or SHRM-CP/SCP certification a plus.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position regularly.
  • Occasionally move about inside the office to access conference rooms, trainings, office machinery, etc.
  • Constantly operate a computer.
  • Occasionally may require light lifting up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment:

  • Office environment.
  • Frequent virtual meetings requiring camera-on participation.
  • Occasional travel to assigned regions as needed.

title: Lead Professional, Project Controls
description:
WSP is currently initiating a search for a Lead Professional, Project Controls for our Power Constructors, Inc. (PCI) sector. Be involved in projects with our P&E team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients’ objectives and solves their challenges.​

This position will have the ability to work remotely from anywhere in the United States. WSP will not provide sponsorship for this position.

WSP brings global expertise in power delivery, power generation, and program management—anchored by the acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. TRC Companies have now joined WSP, deepening our power practice and expanding our energy advisory and intelligent grid services. We're partnering with clients to shape how energy systems evolve around the world—and we need your help.

This Opportunity

Serves as a subject matter expert in project controls by providing leadership and advanced technical expertise across major infrastructure and engineering projects. Oversees the implementation of cost, schedule, and performance control systems that guide project delivery, risk management, and stakeholder reporting. Works collaboratively with project managers, executives, clients, and multidisciplinary teams to ensure accurate forecasting, variance resolution, and alignment of project performance with organizational and contractual goals. Plays a critical role in identifying and driving continuous improvement in control strategies, tools, and standards across the business.

Your Impact

  • Support project initiation by leading the setup of control structures, folders, file share mediums and documentation repositories.
  • Lead bid and proposal audits and compliance checks, ensuring adherence to documentation standards, change management protocols, and corporate policies.
  • Prepare high-level executive dashboards and customized performance summaries for bid status
    Mentor and train project controls staff, promoting consistent execution of control practices and career development.
  • Develop standard operating procedures, reporting templates, and control strategies applicable across a portfolio or region.
  • Support business development and proposal efforts by preparing cost models, staffing projections, and project controls plans.
  • Coordinate across internal departments and external partners to ensure consistency in control practices and reporting.
  • Represent the project controls bid and proposal function in leadership meetings, planning sessions, and client presentations.
  • Track lessons learned from completed proposals and contribute to the evolution of project controls best practices.
  • Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of project records, systems, and audit trails for performance compliance.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, project management, finance, or a related discipline.
  • 7 to 10 years of relevant post education experience in project controls or related areas.
    Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including macros, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and complex data models.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead proposal project control efforts across multi-phase or multidisciplinary engineering and construction programs.
  • Strong analytical skills to identify proposal performance trends, issues, and cost/schedule risks.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating technical performance into executive-level reports.
  • Familiarity with various contracting models, including fixed price, cost-plus, and time-and-materials.
    Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and prioritize control efforts in fast-paced environments.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional teams and ability to build consensus across technical and financial groups.
  • Ability to review, improve, and implement control workflows and reporting systems for enhanced efficiency.
  • Experience presenting to senior leadership and client executives on proposal performance.
  • Understanding of control practices as applied to project development, procurement, and construction phases.

  • Commitment to ethical conduct, transparency, and continuous improvement in control processes.

Preferred Qualifications

title: Shop Tech I - Repair
description:
The Shop Technician I performs various shop functions to support the manufacturing of drill bits. This entry-level role involves hands-on tasks that ensure production runs smoothly, equipment remains in good working condition, and the work environment is safe and clean.

The Shop Technician I works under the supervision of the Shop Supervisor.

This is a fully onsite role with no relocation assistance provided.

Detailed Description:

  • Perform sandblasting and grinding operations on drill bits and components.
  • Wash and clean bits, cutters, and cans to prepare them for subsequent manufacturing steps.
  • Paint drill bits and related components as required, adhering to quality standards.
  • Prepare bits, cutters, and brazing materials for the brazing process, ensuring all components meet production specifications.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by sweeping, removing debris, and following company cleanliness standards.
  • Operate grinders, sandblasters, hoists, and other typical shop tools and equipment in accordance with safety guidelines and company policies.
  • Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies, ensuring compliance with standard operating procedures.
  • Follow instructions provided by bit documentation and management, completing tasks and procedures accurately and on time.
  • Collaborate with team members and supervisors to ensure efficient workflow and address any issues promptly.
  • Perform other shop duties as required or assigned by management.

Job Requirements:

  • Ability to operate standard shop equipment, including grinders, sandblasters, and hoists.
  • Good physical ability to bend, stoop, sit, walk, and perform repetitive tasks.
  • Finger dexterity and visual acuity to handle precision work.
  • Ability to lift, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. and stand for extended periods.
  • Commitment to maintaining a clean and safe work environment.
  • Willingness and availability to work overtime as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience with shop tools and manufacturing equipment.
  • Previous experience working in manufacturing or construction.
  • Experience in an oil field environment.

Additional Details:

The Shop Technician I must work with an emphasis on safety for themselves and others including coworkers and third parties. The typical work environment will be in the shop or field which will require exposure to outdoor weather conditions, loud noise, working near moving mechanical parts, electrical energy, construction equipment, vibration, fumes, chemicals, and airborne particles.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Before we get started:
Here at Ingenio, we'd love to talk with you regardless of your qualifications or years of experience. If you believe you’d be a great fit for this role, we invite you to apply even if you do not meet all points on the job description.

Who we are:
Ingenio is on a mission to make spiritual wellness a core part of modern self-care. We are a global media and technology company developing products that provide guidance on love, relationships, careers, and all aspects of life. We are passionate about connecting people with the world’s best advisors and content to restore spiritual wellness to its rightful place, easing the stress of modern life with trusted ancient practices.

Our global portfolio spans over 20 marketplace and media brands in the spiritual and emotional wellness space. Our flagship brands include Keen, Horoscope.com, Astrology.com, Purple Garden, Kasamba, and Kang.

How you’ll be impactful:
Ingenio's US Marketplace (Keen) is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help lead our next chapter of growth. We've just completed a rebrand and are deep into a full product redesign, and this role builds on that new foundation and turns it into real gains in conversion, revenue, and customer LTV.

People come to Keen at moments that matter, with real questions about their relationships, their careers, and their lives. Whether they find the right advisor, trust them, and come back is what drives the business. You’ll focus on our most critical growth levers: conversion, advisor-consumer matching, recommendations, and monetization and packaging. You’ll own the initiatives that move those numbers, and you'll have real influence on where we place our bets.

We are a small team - five Product and Design people today and growing. You will have real ownership, direct access to leadership, and little distance between your work and the business.

Please note: This role will require being in our SF office at least 3 days per week (Tuesday-Thursday).

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own and obsess over the growth KPIs that matter most: conversion, revenue, and customer LTV. Lead the initiatives that move them, and help shape the longer-term product direction for the customer experience.
  • Drive strategy and execution across key growth areas: conversion optimization, advisor-consumer matching and personalization, pricing, packaging, and monetization experiments, and retention programs.
  • Improve advisor-customer matching through personalization and AI-driven recommendations.
  • Find automation opportunities that improve advisor workflows and the customer experience.
  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities through data analysis, impact modeling, and experimentation, and run a disciplined A/B testing and behavioral analytics practice.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship high-quality experiences quickly, and work with Design on experiences that are both intuitive and effective at driving growth.
  • Work across the whole company, including engineering, customer support, the advisor team, marketing, and data analytics, to turn their insight into product improvements and to make sure what we ship is understood and adopted.
  • Talk directly with customers and advisors to make sure the product is meeting their needs.

What you’ll need to be successful:

  • 6+ years driving growth in consumer (B2C) products, with direct ownership of metrics such as conversion, monetization, retention, or LTV.
  • A demonstrated ability to ship products that drive measurable revenue impact.
  • Obsession with using data to drive impact and prioritization, and a habit of moving quickly from insight to execution.
  • AI fluency, both in the products you ship and in your own workflows. You've shipped features where the output is a model's judgment rather than a fixed rule, and you use AI tools to move faster in your own work.
  • A track record of moving KPIs you influence but don't fully control, and building strong cross-functional relationships to do so.
  • Experience working directly with designers and engineers on ambiguous problems, from framing through launch.
  • Bonus: experience with matching, personalization, recommendations, or search.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Opportunity to work alongside a friendly, talented, and highly collaborative team
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous holiday and PTO policies (including Birthday PTO!)
  • Summer Fridays
  • Technology stipend
  • 401k matching program
  • Lunch
  • Wellness allowance
  • Training and development opportunities and allowance
  • Fun and inclusive in-person and virtual events

Pay Transparency:
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $175,000-$200,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Candidates must have valid work authorization. This role does not sponsor or support new or transferred H-1B, F-1, OPT, STEM OPT, or any other visas.

Why Ingenio?
Our growing team of over 300 employees is powered by our diverse perspectives and company core values:

  • We are humble. We believe the best result is achieved by leveraging others’ perspectives
  • We think like owners. We make decisions that optimize for the greater good of the organization
  • We challenge limiting beliefs. We are at our best when we identify and shatter status quo expectations

Ingenio is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

title: EMSA Business & Technology Coordinator, VC Enrollment Management - UT Chattanooga
description:
The EMSA Business & Technology Coordinator independently analyzes divisional business and technology needs and coordinates solutions across Enrollment Management and Student Affairs. The position supports assigned enterprise applications, investigates complex operational and system issues, leads or coordinates technology-related projects, manages divisional technology assets and access processes, and recommends improvements that strengthen service delivery, compliance, security, and business continuity. The position works under general direction and collaborates with EMSA departments, UTC Information Technology, Procurement, Finance, Facilities, Public Safety, vendors, and other campus partners.

The position does not establish university-wide technology strategy or replace the authority of central Information Technology, Procurement, Information Security, system owners, or data stewards. It provides divisional analysis, functional support, coordination, project leadership, and evidence-based recommendations within approved policies and delegated authority.

Business and Systems Analysis

  • Independently assess departmental workflows, technology needs, service challenges, and operational risks.
  • Gather and document business requirements; map current-state and future-state processes; translate operational needs into functional requirements.
  • Analyze the causes and effects of system, process, access, and service issues and recommend appropriate system, process, training, or policy solutions.
  • Evaluate proposed changes based on operational impact, risk, cost, service continuity, feasibility, and alignment with divisional priorities.

  • Facilitate process-mapping, requirements-gathering, and solution-review sessions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Serve as a divisional functional resource for assigned enterprise and administrative technology platforms.
  • Investigate complex system errors, workflow failures, integration concerns, access problems, and recurring user issues; coordinate resolution with appropriate technical owners and vendors.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, system upgrades, configuration reviews, release readiness, documentation, communication, and post-implementation support.

  • Maintain application support information, system ownership records, vendor contacts, escalation paths, and continuity documentation.

  • Monitor patterns in incidents and service requests and recommend sustainable corrective actions.

  • Assigned platforms may include StarRez, Banner, Maxient, TouchNet, 25Live, TMA, Medicat, Fusion, Bluefin, MocSync, and other EMSA systems. The supervisor will establish the employees’ primary and secondary system portfolio.

Technology Projects and Process Improvement

  • Maintain centralized records for EMSA technology assets, assigned users, warranties, software licenses, and lifecycle status.

  • Coordinate equipment deployment, reassignment, recovery, replacement, imaging, surplus, and disposal with appropriate campus offices.

  • Coordinate role-based system and facility-access requests for onboarding, transfers, job changes, and offboarding.

  • Conduct or coordinate periodic inventory and access reviews; identify discrepancies, inappropriate access, unsupported technology, and continuity risks.

  • Maintain checklists, records, and continuity documentation that support audit readiness and uninterrupted divisional services.

  • Escalate suspected unauthorized access, data exposure, cybersecurity events, or extended service outages according to university requirements.

Vendor, Procurement, and Technology Lifecycle Coordination

  • Coordinate vendor meetings, demonstrations, support cases, implementation activities, upgrades, and service-performance discussions.

  • Track software renewals, license commitments, warranties, contract milestones, support terms, and required documentation.

  • Obtain quotes and compare pricing, functionality, support levels, implementation requirements, and total lifecycle costs.

  • Prepare evidence-based recommendations for technology purchases, replacements, renewals, and investments for leadership review.

  • Coordinate approved purchasing and contract documentation with EMSA Business Affairs, Procurement, Information Technology, and other authorized offices.

Reporting, Documentation, Training, and Governance

  • Maintain divisional technology project, issue, risk, renewal, and decision records.

  • Prepare concise reports on technology operations, investments, risks, dependencies, and project status for EMSA leadership.

  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, user guides, support resources, and training materials.

  • Provide training and consultation to technical and non-technical users on approved systems and processes.

  • Participate in relevant divisional and campus technology, operations, and project meetings.

Competencies/Qualifications

  • Knowledge of business analysis, systems support, process improvement, project coordination, technology lifecycle management, and customer-service principles.
  • Ability to independently analyze complex operational and technology issues, identify root causes, evaluate options, and present practical recommendations.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical stakeholders and communicate clearly with users at different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple systems, projects, deadlines, vendors, and stakeholders while maintaining accurate records and follow-through.
  • Ability to assess operational risk, protect confidential information, and follow university security, privacy, procurement, records, and acceptable-use requirements.
  • Ability to lead meetings, facilitate decisions, manage conflict, and influence work without formal authority.
  • Skill in requirements documentation, process mapping, testing coordination, report preparation, training, and standard operating procedure development.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and the ability to learn and support enterprise software applications

Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer information systems, business administration, higher education administration, business analytics, project management, or a related field.

Experience four years of progressively responsible experience in business systems analysis, enterprise application support, technology operations, project coordination, process improvement, or a related field. Experience must include independent problem analysis and coordination across multiple stakeholders. Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.

Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree. Experience supporting enterprise applications in higher education, student affairs, enrollment management, or another complex service environment gathering business requirements, mapping processes, coordinating user acceptance testing, and supporting system implementations or upgrades.

Experience with technology asset management, role-based access, procurement coordination, vendor management, contract renewals, or business continuity planning. Leading cross-functional projects without direct supervisory authority. Project management, business analysis, IT service management, change management, or relevant application certification.

title: Quality Engineer Technician
description:
The Quality Engineer Technician is responsible for supporting quality assurance and quality control activities within manufacturing and production processes. This role ensures that products meet company standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements through inspections, testing, data analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

You will report directly to our Quality Engineer Manager, and you will work out of our Acton, MA location on an On-site work schedule.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform incoming, in-process, and final inspections of materials and finished products
  • Conduct measurement and testing using tools such as calipers, micrometers, gauges, and CMM (if applicable)
  • Record and analyze quality data to identify trends, defects, and areas for improvement
  • Support investigation of non-conforming materials and assist with root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective actions (CAPA)
  • Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including inspection reports, test results, and control plans
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, company procedures, and customer requirements
  • Assist in process audits and internal quality audits
  • Collaborate with production, engineering, and supplier teams to resolve quality issues
  • Support implementation of continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.)
  • Participate in first article inspections (FAI) and validation activities
  • Maintain calibration records and ensure proper use of inspection equipment

YOU MUST HAVE

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience in a manufacturing or quality environment
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, and specifications
  • Experience with inspection tools and measurement systems
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office, quality systems software)


WE VALUE

  • College degree or technical certification in Quality, Manufacturing, or related field preferred
  • Basic knowledge of quality systems and standards (ISO 9001, IATF 16949, etc.)
  • Experience with statistical process control (SPC) and data analysis
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experience with SAP
  • Knowledge of quality management systems (QMS)
  • Certification such as ASQ Certified Quality Technician (CQT)

title: Advanced Technical Artist
description:
Advanced Technical Artist

Would you like to help push the visual quality of current and future games across some of the greatest franchises in gaming history, as well as new original IP? Certain Affinity has physical locations in Austin, Texas, and Toronto, Canada. Our culture reflects the values and vibrant nature of the cities we call home, including a commitment to evolution, diversity, excellence, and work-life balance. We are best known for co-developing numerous AAA FPS games, and we are continuing to expand the quality, ambition, and technical sophistication of the experiences we help bring to life.
As a Senior Advanced Technical Artist, you will play a hands-on role in improving the visual fidelity, efficiency, and scalability of our art pipelines for current projects. You will partner closely with Art, Design, Engineering, VFX, and Rendering to develop tools, workflows, materials, simulations, and content pipelines that help teams achieve a high-quality visual target while maintaining strong performance and iteration speed.
This role reports to the Technical Art Director and is ideal for someone who combines deep production experience with strong technical judgment, a sharp eye for visual quality, and the ability to solve complex cross-discipline problems in Unreal Engine.


Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain scalable Technical Art workflows, tools, and pipelines that support high-quality visual execution across current projects.
  • Partner with Art, VFX, Design, Engineering, and Rendering to improve visual fidelity, content iteration, and runtime performance in Unreal Engine.
  • Support VFX pipeline development, simulation workflows, material systems, and content integration to help achieve project visual targets.
  • Identify pipeline gaps and implement pragmatic, production-ready solutions that unblock teams and improve asset quality, consistency, and throughput.
  • Build and deploy tools using Python, Unreal Editor Utility Blueprints, Houdini Digital Assets, or similar technologies to streamline content creation and validation.
  • Own and improve core art pipelines, ensuring they remain stable, efficient, performance-conscious, and adaptable as project needs evolve.
  • Troubleshoot complex content, rendering, material, VFX, and performance issues across multiple disciplines.
  • Establish best practices for visual quality and technical scalability, including Nanite usage, texture streaming, LODs, material complexity, profiling, and optimization workflows.
  • Facilitate clear cross-discipline communication to align visual goals, technical constraints, and production priorities.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of game industry experience, with 4+ years in a Technical Artist role
  • Proven experience standing up or significantly evolving pipelines in early or ambiguous production phases
  • Shipped 1+ AAA title as a Technical Artist
  • Strong scripting or programming skills (Python, MEL, C#, or C++) with a focus on rapid tool development
  • Experience working with both lighting and VFX in Unreal Engine
  • Knowledge in FluidNinja, Chaos Physics, and EmberGen
  • Deep familiarity with Unreal Engine systems, including Materials/Shader Graph, Blueprint workflows, and performance profiling tools (e.g., Unreal Insights, Stat commands)
  • Expert-level experience with at least one DCC package (Maya, Max, Blender, or similar) including asset prep and export pipelines
  • Experience building or supporting environment art workflows and content pipelines (e.g., Substance Designer/Painter, Houdini for procedural generation)
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize speed and impact in a fast-moving environment
  • Clear communication and ability to operate effectively within a small, highly collaborative team
  • Portfolio demonstrating tools, workflows, or pipeline solutions that improved team velocity
  • A desire to work in a diverse and inclusive environment
Extra Credit
  • Experience working in small or strike teams, covering multiple roles across Tech Art, Tools, and Rendering
  • Experience supporting animation or technical animation workflows (e.g., Control Rig, Animation Blueprints, state machines, or runtime rigging/debugging)
  • Experience setting up or improving content validation and build pipelines
  • Experience creating documentation and onboarding workflows
  • Ability to evaluate and integrate third-party tools or middleware to accelerate development

title: Associate Director, Antibody Discovery
description:
Role Location: Athens, GA

The Company
We are Alloy Therapeutics — a biotechnology ecosystem and Product Development Organization (PDO) empowering the global scientific community to make better medicines together. Through a community of partners, we democratize access to pre-competitive tools, technologies, services, and company creation capabilities that are foundational for discovering and developing therapeutic biologics. The company facilitates affordable, non-exclusive access to the entire drug discovery community from academic scientists, small and medium biotech, to the largest biopharma. At Alloy, we believe our industry should compete on getting the best drugs to patients as quickly as possible, not exclusive access to the best platforms. As a reflection of our relentless commitment to the scientific community, we reinvest 100% of our revenue in innovation and access to innovation. May the Best Drug Win.

Alloy has evolved from a startup into a global product development organization operating 11 divisions across 5 research sites in 4 countries on 3 continents. Our model - Integrated Independence - combines centralized capabilities with entrepreneurial operating divisions. Successful members thrive in our shared culture of accountability, deliberate trust, and open communication. As a team we aspire to work together to exceed expectations and collectively contribute across the global organization to always maintain our nimble, startup culture.

At Alloy, we have an ethos of "Mentorship-By-Apprenticeship" in all of our positions. We strive to have workers in the office when needed to interact organically and face-to-face. Of course, as a lab-based operation, our cells and animals grow 7 days a week, 365 days per year. We respect and value our colleagues for their hard work that requires them to be in the lab every day. We ask our people who have more flexible accommodations to appreciate their colleagues who have less flexibility. We are all one team!

About the Role at Alloy Therapeutics
As Associate Director of Antibody Discovery Programs, you will play a key role in shaping and leading strategies for our antibody discovery initiatives. This position entails driving the discovery of novel antibody-based therapeutics, including monoclonal and bispecific antibodies. You will be accountable for scientific oversight of dozens of therapeutic discovery programs every year by working collaboratively with a range of large pharma companies, emerging biotech companies and academic collaborators.

A crucial aspect of this role involves contributing a deep understanding of drug discovery projects to drive effective project strategies in collaboration with our partners. Strong communication skills are essential for this role, as you will interact with a diverse group of stakeholders both within and outside the company. You will also be accountable for high quality partner communication throughout the project life cycles, including drafting research proposals, updating project status and timelines, and presenting final deliveries.

This role will report directly to the Vice President of Antibody Powered Division in Athens, GA, with autonomy owning various stakeholders, projects, and tasks in a dynamic start-up environment while keeping up the pace of Alloy.

How You’ll Drive Impact
  • Drive: Scientific direction and execution of monoclonal and bispecific discovery projects.
  • Innovate: Ensure the application of cutting-edge technologies and methodologies in antibody discovery projects.
  • Collaborate: Integrate protein engineering and cutting-edge efforts efficiently into product offerings and engage with external collaborators in discovery of biologics.
  • Deliver: Efficient execution of partner projects balancing quality, timelines, and costs, while ensuring successful completion of therapeutic discovery that meet our partners’ objectives.
  • Lead: Marshall, inspire, and mentor a cross-functional team of scientists. Lead by example by going the extra mile to ensure we are successful delivering on projects.
  • Communicate: Communicate effectively with key stakeholders externally and internally, fostering productive interactions both upward and downward, and across teams at different sites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Accountable for scientific success of antibody discovery and engineering campaigns.
  • Drive major decisions, balance tradeoffs and resolve technical issues with a campaign.
  • Coordinate execution and partner relationship with alliance management and project management.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives across ADS functional areas.
  • Bring innovative scientific and technological solutions to increase business competitiveness.

Qualifications
  • You have a PhD in a relevant scientific field (e.g. Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biology) with a minimum of 6 years of industry experience in early drug discovery and development, or a master’s degree with 10+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • You have broad and deep experience with antibody discovery and engineering.
  • You have a strong background in the design and optimization of antibody-based therapeutics.
  • You have a proven track record of successful execution and delivery of projects within scope, budget, and timeline.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
  • You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
  • You have excellent people skills and thrive in a team environment, with the ability to motivate and mentor team members.
  • You have the ability to work across various US and international time zones.
  • You are able to accommodate occasional travel as needed (10%).
  • You are able to work on-site in Athens, GA

Taking Care of Our People
We support the individuality of what people need to do outside of work to empower them to do their best at work. While you focus on making better medicine together, we focus on programs and benefits that support a diverse and growing team. Whether you’re single, in a growing family, or nearing retirement, Alloy offers a variety of comprehensive and competitive benefits starting from day one.

Compensation
  • Competitive base and equity compensation commensurate with level of experience and independence
  • 401(k) company match
Health & Family
  • Generous personal and family medical, dental and vision benefits with 100% of premiums and deductibles covered
  • Company-paid disability (STD, LTD) and life insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • Family planning support up to $45,000 (e.g., IVF/PGT, adoption, surrogacy, egg retrieval)
Unique Perks
  • Unlimited PTO (paid time off) and flexible schedules
  • Annual stipend for continuing education with commitment to your career through individualized professional development plan
  • Wellness and Extensive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) including resources for mental wellness

Pay Transparency

📈 Financial advisor and financial wellness support

🏖️ Flexible PTO and generous company holidays, including Juneteenth and Winter Break

description:
Job Description


Job Summary

Provides strategy and leadership to team responsible for enterprise project and portfolio management activities. Oversees project and portfolio management across mergers and acquisitions (M&A), growth, and other business initiatives - ensuring successful delivery of programs while maintaining strong financial governance. Demonstrates oversight for technology project portfolios, supports quality assurance, capital planning and budgeting efforts, and ensures delivery excellence.

Job Duties

  • Supports strategy development, vision and direction for project and portfolio management activities across the Molina enterprise. Demonstrates accountability for performance and financial results, and keeps executive leadership apprised.
  • Leads cross-functional teams supporting delivery of multiple project portfolios to include dependencies, risks, timelines, and execution across organizational initiatives.
  • Manages portfolios to include technology, business, change initiatives and integration efforts.
  • Ensures multiple programs and projects are synchronized in alignment with organizational priorities, governance standards and business objectives.
  • Leads intake processes, prioritization, protocols and escalation pathways.
  • Oversees quality and risk management across projects.
  • Manages portfolio delivery across multiple functions including but not limited to quality, risk adjustment, and enterprise information management (EIM).
  • Demonstrates understanding of multiple projects and relationships between projects and represents as an expert in project management methods and techniques.
  • Assesses projects for potential problem areas; investigates, develops, and evaluates solutions to a wide range of complex problems spanning across multiple projects within portfolios.
  • Provides oversight into go live technology initiatives and other programs.
  • Supports artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives, HR, technology and transformation initiatives.
  • Introduces improvements to portfolio planning practices, including clear scope delineation to ensure robust and accurate initial cost estimates.
  • Provides guidance to ensure alignment between portfolio delivery plans and financial commitments.
  • Collaborates closely with stakeholders to develop functional/SIT, regression, E2E and performance test scope.
  • Monitors test execution, identifies risk and mitigation plans, and communicates with project stakeholders.
  • Leverages industry leading testing trends and tools, such as test automation, AI and synthetic data generation.
  • Hires, trains, manages and evaluates team member performance - provides coaching, development, and recognition ensures ongoing appropriate staff training, holds regular team meetings, and drives communication and collaboration.
  • Develops and sustains a high-performance team, dedicated to best-in-class solutions; responsible for attracting, developing and retaining top-tier talent to support strategy and long-term business objectives.

Job Qualifications

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 10 years of progressive leadership experience in health care operations, technology, integration and project and portfolio management, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • At least 5 years of management/leadership experience.
  • Deep project and portfolio management experience.
  • Advanced Agile, Jira, and AI experience.
  • Strong experience supporting quality assurance and process improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Highly organized and self-motivated.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Microsoft Office suite/applicable software programs proficiency.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Formal training in project management.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or Six Sigma green belt certification.

Compensation

$15-$18 per hour, based on experience and location, plus performance-based bonus opportunities. Total earnings increase with strong individual and branch performance.

World Finance has been recognized as a Top Workplace USA for six consecutive years and a Newsweek Most Trustworthy Company. Experience & Skills:

  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills

  • Basic computer skills with accurate and consistent data entry

Preferred Backgrounds:

Experience in banking, retail, restaurants, hospitality, collections, call centers, insurance, healthcare front office, or similar customer-facing roles is preferred.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Operates, calibrates, installs, programs, repairs, designs, and fabricates instrumentation and data acquisition systems.
  • Maintains data acquisition systems, test cells operations, rigs and rig rooms; calibrates, installs, programs, troubleshoots, repairs and assembles test systems, general and specialized instrumentation.

  • Fabricates and assembles test fixtures and servo-hydraulic systems; operates, troubleshoots, and repairs hydraulic systems, shakers, and rigs; calibrates transducers and systems; installs and calibrates strain gauges and thermocouples (micro).
  • Maintains parts and equipment inventories.
  • Creates and maintains electronic documentation.
  • Uses a number of general tools including but not limited to digital multimeter, soldering iron, function generator, and frequency generator.
  • Reads and interprets electrical wiring diagrams.
  • Understands and applies appropriate company and department rules and guidelines to work.
  • Works with and trains apprentices and technicians.
  • Interfaces with customers, suppliers, engineers, and other functions.
  • Coordinates programs including planning, scheduling, ordering, and tracking.
  • Participates in the maintenance of quality procedures.
  • Leads and participate in improvement projects.
  • Develops and gives presentations to customers and suppliers.
  • Knows and complies with all safety policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrates confidentiality as required.
  • Participates in self- and team-audits and associated corrective action.
  • Performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to get the job done.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Data Acquisition - Prepares samples, verifies equipment calibration and performs tests according to an approved standard procedure or work instruction in a manner which ensures, and results in, data that can be trusted and delivered to the engineer or customer.
  • Data Reporting - Prepares documentation in a manner which clearly organizes and presents testing methods, instrument settings, the data and analysis to allow the engineer and customer to understand the results and form accurate conclusions and recommendations.
  • Product Function Test System Design - Interprets test equipment specifications from test standards or lab customer requirements; selects and integrates appropriate equipment, instrumentation and software to control boundary conditions and collect measurement data; assesses capability of the lab equipment against the requirements and support infrastructure.
  • Test Article Build - Assembles test articles according to test requirements, including all necessary installation or accommodations for instrumentation, in a manner that allows the test articles to successfully undergo product functional test.
  • Test Setup and Configuration - Interprets test plan to determine optimal location and orientation within a test space in accordance with local safety and environmental requirements and fabricates required system with appropriate materials.
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  • Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Preventative and Predictive Maintenance - Interprets machine and tool maintenance records and data to develop and execute preventative and predictive management strategies to drive continuous improvement within the manufacturing process.
  • Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma, GED or equivalent required with Department of Labor Certification OR Associates degree from an accredited program in a related field and at least two years of relevant experience OR Bachelors degree in a related field OR Relevant military education and experience.

Experience:

High school diploma, GED or equivalent required with Department of Labor Certification OR Associates degree from an accredited program in a related field and at least two years of relevant experience OR Bachelors degree in a related field OR Relevant military education and experience

  • This position is responsible for delivering superior results by supporting high-quality emissions testing within the Power-Train Emissions Laboratory. The role executes work orders, test plans, and standard operating procedures while ensuring technical excellence, regulatory compliance, data integrity, and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities include maintaining accurate electronic documentation, supporting quality verification activities, troubleshooting instrumentation and facility issues, and contributing to the reliable operation of emissions test systems.
  • The position also supports the overall effectiveness and capability of the laboratory through preventive and corrective maintenance, instrumentation calibration, continuous improvement initiatives, capital and facility projects, and development of technical documentation. Team members are expected to continually expand their technical knowledge and capabilities, developing increasing proficiency in the operation, calibration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of emissions testing systems and laboratory instrumentation. As experience is gained, individuals are expected to build the technical depth necessary to support increasingly complex equipment, contribute to equipment rebuilds and system improvements, mentor other team members, and serve as a technical resource within the laboratory.
  • The role requires flexibility, a continuous learning mindset, and the ability to develop broad technical capability across laboratory operations. Team members collaborate across functional areas to meet changing business priorities and, as operational needs allow, provide technical support to other OLY Engine, Chassis, and Power-Train laboratories, helping ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality testing operations across the site.

title: Supply Chain Specialist
description:
About Mach Industries

Founded in 2022, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. At the core of our mission is the commitment to delivering scalable, decentralized defense systems that enhance the strategic capabilities of the United States and its allies. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and driven Supply Chain Specialist to support purchasing activities within our supply chain team. This role will be focused on executing day-to-day procurement tasks in the ERP system, placing and tracking purchase orders, managing request status, and ensuring timely delivery of materials to support production and engineering programs. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, demonstrate strong organizational skills, and serve as a key liaison between our internal teams and external suppliers. This role is critical in ensuring supply continuity and supporting the broader objectives of the supply chain team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and manage purchase orders (POs) within the ERP system based on demand signals, MRP recommendations, and internal requests.

  • Track and update PO status, ensuring suppliers acknowledge, confirm, and deliver orders on time.

  • Execute order management activities including reschedules, cancellations, and expedite requests in coordination with Global Supply Managers.

  • Follow up with suppliers regularly to monitor order progress, resolve delivery issues, and maintain accurate ship dates.

  • Support “Clear to Build” reviews by confirming material availability against program requirements and escalating gaps.

  • Maintain accurate records of procurement transactions and supplier communications for traceability and audit readiness.

  • Assist in onboarding new suppliers, obtaining quotes, and setting up vendor master data in coordination with supply managers and finance.

  • Collaborate with receiving and inventory teams to resolve discrepancies, blocked invoices, and receiving issues.

  • Communicate proactively with engineering, planning, and production teams to ensure alignment on priorities and material needs.

  • Participate in continuous improvement of procurement workflows and support implementation of supply chain tools and dashboards.

  • Assist in varied sourcing and supply chain development activities/

  • Support cross-functional projects and broader supply chain initiatives as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain/Operations Management, Business, or equivalent. (3+ years of relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.)

  • 1+ years of demonstrated success in a supply chain role.

  • Proven experience in procurement operations and supplier management.

  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Knowledge of enterprise applications (i.e., PLM, ERP, MES) and proficient in data analysis.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing industries.

  • Understanding of defense compliance (ITAR, EAR, NDAA).

  • Exposure to startup or growth-stage operations.

Disclosures

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Please note that any offer for employment may be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations without sponsorship for an export license.

Mach participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offers may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and training, critical skills, and business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in most offers and are considered part of Mach’s total compensation package. Mach offers benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, and opportunities for professional development.

Mach is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, Veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws. title: ICITAP Advisor to the Albanian Police Oversight Agency
description:
Amentum is a premier global services partner supporting critical programs of national significance across defense, security, intelligence, energy, and environment. Amentum draws from a century-old heritage of operational excellence, mission focus, and successful execution underpinned by a strong culture of safety and ethics. Headquartered in Chantilly, VA., Amentum employs more than 50,000 people on all seven continents.

Amentum is supporting the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) in providing specialized training, advisory and mentoring services to host nations under the Criminal Division’s International Criminal Investigative Training and Assistance Program (ICITAP).

ICITAP is a cornerstone of America’s global strategy for combating transnational crime, terrorism, countering trafficking in persons, establishing rule of law and enhancing human rights in developing countries. Amentum is the contract service provider to the DOJ ICITAP and Overseas Prosecutorial Development, Assistance and Training (OPDAT) programs.

The ICITAP-Albania Law Enforcement Development Program, funded by the U.S. Department of State’s Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs, offers law enforcement support through a comprehensive and integrated program of training, technical assistance, and equipment donations to assist Albania’s law enforcement institutions to advance the America First foreign policy by combating transnational organized crime.

Please Note: This is an Independent Contractor position with Amentum and should not be considered an employment relationship with Amentum.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Amentum is currently seeking a qualified candidate to serve as the principal Senior Advisor to the Albanian Police Oversight Agency (POA) in Tirana, Albania. This position will work directly with the POA to support operational effectiveness through sustained advisory support and training. The POA Advisor will oversee the management policies and procedures for inspection of police units to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures and investigations of allegations of police criminal misconduct. The Advisor will be tasked with ensuring the POA can proactively investigate officials suspected of corruption and criminal misconduct, including acts involving facilitation of organized crime. This position will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) and coordinator for POA program implementation.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The POA Advisor will positively mentor and advise the POA Director General.
  • Conduct training of police oversight inspectors and investigators to improve their ability to detect and investigate violations of standard procedures and law.
  • Advise POA leadership on public affairs efforts to increase transparency and accountability to Albanian citizens.
  • Monitor sustainment of the polygraph examination sector as part of the police vetting process.
  • Identify POA equipment needs and recommend procurement actions to meet the most critical requirements.
  • Monitor the vetting process to ensure objectivity and compliance with the Vetting law.
  • Advise on the development of career path and employee evaluation processes.
  • Review investigative and inspection reports.
  • Mentor POA investigators on proper analyses of investigative and inspection reports.
  • Monitor POA inspections.
  • The POA Advisor will report to the ICITAP Albania Law Enforcement Assistance Attache in Tirana. The POA Advisor will contribute to ICITAP’s reporting on POA activities to include submissions for the ICITAP Huddles and monthly and quarterly reports.
    • Other ad hoc tasks to fulfil mission critical activities as determined by ICITAP.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen eligible to obtain a U.S. security clearance at the time of employment.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in police oversight or internal affairs.
  • Specialized investigative experience in the field(s) of police oversight, and/or public corruption.
  • Experience as an instructor in fields related to criminal investigations involving allegations against law enforcement personnel.
  • Documented advanced report writing skills.
  • Documented ability to assess, evaluate, and produce written communications articulating necessary steps to address sustainable staffing, structure, policy, training, and equipment needs of police oversight personnel tasked with conducting criminal investigations of police misconduct.
  • Pragmatic and solutions oriented.
  • Ability to influence and inspire workplace change.
  • Ability to influence multiple stakeholders and engage people at every level of host organization.
  • Demonstrates integrity and fairness.
  • Collaborates in building team morale and consensus.
  • Writes and speaks clearly and convincingly.
  • Listens actively and responds effectively.
  • Actively builds deep knowledge in one or more areas.
  • Can act as mentor for others.
  • International experience working within a Country Team setting at a U.S. embassy abroad.

ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Knowledge of international operations.
    Knowledge of the Western Balkans.
  • Albanian or Italian language skills.

530.80/day

title: Data Centre Liquid Cooling Engineer
description:
Job Family Group:

Research & Technology Group


Job Description:

The Advanced Electrification Testing (AET) team sits within the Technology division of Castrol. The
purpose of the team is to undertake testing, provide engineering support and thought leadership to Castrol’s Research and Product Development teams. Areas of current technology development are centred on thermal managent fluids for electric vehicle batteries, data centres, and electric vehicle charging equipment.
The team is responsible for a range testing facilities at the bp Pangbourne Technology Centre in the UK and at other sites in the US. Currently a major programme of investment is in progress to transition the Pangbourne campus into a centre of excellence for electric mobility and energy technologies. In the comingyears the AET team will operate a new battery testing centre with capability for climatic testing of battery cells, modules and packs and electric vehicle chargers. There is also a newly opened Data Centre Test Facility which includes several immersion tanks for server testing.


The Engineer will be co-located within a non operated joint venture company in San Jose, California, that specializes in data centre cooling technology in the centre of Silicon Valley. They will be responsible for the execution of research and development projects, testing and engineering projects in support of Castrol’s data centre and thermal management business. This can encompass a wide variety different activities ranging from executing standard test method through to development of novel and innovative testing techniques on the latest developmental equipment. The scope of the AET team current spans, mobility, power and data centre industries with applications ranging from electric vehicle batteries through to data centre servers and networks. However in each the technical areas of focus in our projects are invariably, thermal management and cooling, system power flow control and measurement, electronics performance, instrumentation and high accuracy testing to produce meaningful conclusions. Co-located with the data centre join venture company, the Engineer will specialize in the field of data centre liquid cooling.


The Engineer will work with the Castrol Technology and business stakeholders in all aspects of the project definition, execution and reporting. It is expected that they may work alongside and in some cases under the supervision of Senior Engineers, Expert Engineers and the AET manager.


It is expected that the Engineer will actively progress their professional and personal competency
development to a level that will allow them to proficiently deliver all aspects of a testing or engineering project autonomously with little to no supervision. This may include pursuit of professional accreditation from an engineering industry body.

Key Accountabilities

• Implementing research and development testing projects in the department.
• Domain specialism in the field of data centre liquid cooling.
• Design of Experiment (DoE) using statistical techniques.
• Data analysis and technical reporting.
• Engineering support for the design, installation and operation of test equipment.
• Maintaining regular project status update reports according to AET policies and practices.
• Maintaining effective networks and relationships with key internal collaborators.
• Visible role model within the team in maintaining high operational and HSSEQ standards

Essential Education

Degree in a relevant engineering / science field.

Essential Experience

• Over 3 years working as a professional engineer in engineering roles.
• Domain expertise in data centres liquid cooling.

• Self-starer, and able to work with some supervision in the execution of research and development
testing projects, including data analysis and reporting.

Desirable Criteria

• Masters degree or PhD in a relevant engineering / science field.
• Chartered membership of a industry recognized engineering organization.
• Over 2 years experience in a professional engineering testing environment.
• Over 2 years experience working in an operational engineering / safety critical environment.
• Author of peer reviewed published technical papers.
• Expertise in data analytics or specialist measurement techniques.
• Profficient in Computer Aided Engineering tools.
• Knowledge and experience of immersion cooling of high voltage (>30V AC, 60V DC) electrical
systems.
• Knowledge and experience of data centre technologies.


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
As this is a safety critical operational role, the Engineer will be expected to be on site whenever required to facilitate the efficient execution of testing and team activities. Occasional working from home will be possible as operations and activities within the team allow.

title: Shelter Worker (Casual)
description:
Who We Are

For more than 130 years, The Salvation Army has served people in need in communities across Canada and Bermuda. Building on our roots as a world-wide Christian church, each year we help more than 2 million people, providing necessities such as food, clothing and shelter. In addition, we support people experiencing unemployment, addiction and family challenges. We continually adapt and innovate to meet emerging needs and live out our mission, vision and values of hope, service, dignity and stewardship. As a faith- and values-based organization, we hire and serve people of all backgrounds and walks of life - there is a place for everyone to belong here.

Mission Statement

The Salvation Army exists to share the love of Jesus Christ, meet human needs and be a transforming influence in the communities of our world.

Job Description:

Location: Richmond House

POSITION PURPOSE SUMMARY:

  • Monitors the activities of the guests; may include providing safe storage and recording of prescribed medications, doing basic in-take and complete paperwork, orientation of new guests, ensures ongoing enforcement of policies, which may include enforcing restrictions.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Adheres to the policies and standards of The Salvation Army as established in policy and program manuals, Health & Safety Guidelines, job descriptions, written memos, and verbal agreements.
  • Maintain the cleanliness and order of the shelter while on duty.
  • Carry out inspection/security checks of property and grounds in accordance with policies and procedures
  • Carry out inspection of neighboring properties and remove any drug or alcohol paraphernalia using safe procedures, in accordance to our Good Neighbour Policy and
  • Accurately records day-to-day happenings using appropriate methods; maintains logbooks appropriately and completes incident reports
  • Responsible for the care and safety of guests in the Shelter, as well as the premises itself, including doing bed checks, room/personal searches. Establish clear, simple, and consistent limits for the guests. Encourage and facilitate the participation of guests to create a safe, positive atmosphere.
  • Prepares and serves breakfast for guests, sets up coffee bar, may prepare or provide simple meals for guests
  • Work with Case Workers to assist guests in working through their case plans as appropriate, providing personal, practical, and moral support to guests and feedback to Case Workers
  • Engage with guests by providing activities as appropriate, i.e. Sports, crafts, games
  • Liaises with referral sources and other external agencies as needed (e.g., , Ministry of Social Development-Income Assistance office, RCMP, BC Housing, etc.
  • Attend staff and any other meetings called or directed to by the supervisor.
  • May serve as Receptionist for Shelter
  • Maintain professional growth through attending workshops, courses and by reviewing current information/resources. Attend any training courses, workshops as directed by the supervisor.
  • Forster and nurture a positive professional team environment at all times.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all knowledge of and information about guests
  • Perform other duties as assigned, which may include, but not limited to: general admin duties (making calls, sending emails, photocopying, scanning documents, resourcing resources for clients, updating folders at front desk, making posters, assisting with maintaining staff bulletin board, assist in facilitating workshops and groups)

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Willingness to adhere to the Mission Statement of The Salvation Army Richmond House Emergency Shelter.
  • Post-secondary education in Social Services or a related field, or combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum two years of previous experience and/or training working with the homeless and have a good working knowledge of homelessness, mental health and addiction issues
  • Training in Vulnerability Assessment Tool (VAT)
  • Training in crisis intervention, conflict resolution and mediation skills is essential.
  • Must demonstrate a positive attitude towards the homeless and individuals with substance abuse and concurrent problems, including mental health concerns.
  • Must have First Aid and CPR certificate

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must obtain Criminal Record Check in accordance with Criminal Records Review Program.
  • Intermediate computer skills.
  • Commitment to a problem-solving approach.
  • Ability to work independently, set priorities, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to identify sensitive issues and maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Must be sensitive to and respectful of cultural and lifestyle diversity.

The incumbent works in generally agreeable conditions, with the following exceptions:

  • Dealing with angry people
  • Verbal abuse
  • Multi-tasking

The incumbent must take the following precautionary measures (in addition to health and safety rules):

  • Universal Precautions
  • Immunization for Hepatitis B
  • Vaccination against Tuberculosis

Compensation:

The target hiring range for this position is $24.70 to $24.95 with a maximum of $25.20.

Placement in the salary range will be based on factors such as market conditions, internal equity, and candidate experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role.

The Salvation Army will provide reasonable accommodation upon request. Please email Recruitment.Accommodations@salvationarmy.ca if you have a need for any accommodation and we will be pleased to discuss this with you.
