title: Asset Protection Detective, Queens Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Detective, you will help protect company assets, reduce shortage, and support a safe, customer-focused shopping environment. Using surveillance, investigative tools, and strong partnerships with store teams and law enforcement, you will identify and respond to theft, recover merchandise, and help protect our customers, colleagues, and business.

Why This Role Matters

Asset Protection Detectives play an important role in reducing loss while maintaining a safe and welcoming store environment. Through training, observation, investigation, and de-escalation, this role helps protect company assets, support colleagues, and ensure customers can shop with confidence.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

What To Expect

  • Use surveillance techniques, investigative tools, and reporting systems to help identify theft, dishonest activity, and shortage trends.
  • Partner with Asset Protection leaders, store teams, and law enforcement to support investigations and protect company assets.
  • Apply de-escalation tools and sound judgment to help maintain a safe environment for customers and colleagues.
  • Prepare clear documentation, statements, and evidence to support investigations, audits, and legal proceedings.
  • Support team readiness by training colleagues on protocols that help protect company assets.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Help protect customers, colleagues, and company assets by identifying, investigating, and responding to theft and dishonest activity.
  • Use surveillance techniques to support the apprehension of shoplifters and dishonest employees, while following company policies and legal requirements.
  • Recover stolen merchandise and provide statements, evidence, and documentation to support investigations.
  • Prepare timely and accurate reports related to theft incidents, investigations, audits, and assigned activities.
  • Build strong partnerships with store colleagues, Asset Protection leaders, and law enforcement to support investigations and shortage reduction.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, and evidence preservation.
  • Testify in court for criminal and civil cases, as needed.
  • Respond to alarm calls, support special assignments, and facilitate first aid for customers and colleagues when needed.
  • Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships with colleagues, customers, and communities.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Ability to observe, identify, and respond to suspicious activity in a retail environment.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with customers, colleagues, leaders, and law enforcement.
  • Ability to use sound judgment, de-escalation tools, and company procedures to support a safe environment.
  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.
  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, asset protection, security, investigations, or law enforcement.
  • Ability to prepare accurate reports, statements, and documentation related to incidents and investigations.
  • Experience using surveillance systems, reporting tools, or investigative technology.
  • Ability to train or coach colleagues on asset protection protocols, shortage reduction, or safety practices.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.
  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.
  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.
  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

Job Summary:

The Senior Continuous Improvement Analyst leads assigned Continuous Improvement (CI), Business Process Management (BPM), and process modernization initiatives within People & Culture.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Business Process Management, People Systems & Analytics, the incumbent improves how work is designed, delivered, measured, standardized, and sustained, with a focus on operational efficiency, service effectiveness, process performance, and end-user experience.

This is a practical, delivery-focused role. It is not a traditional Lean Six Sigma role centered on workshops, waste reduction, or process documentation. The incumbent must bring structure to complex or not-yet-fully-defined business problems, connect information across teams, systems, handoffs, data, and outcomes, and move initiatives from discovery through implementation, measurement, and sustained adoption.

Strategic direction, process governance, process architecture, and the broader modernization roadmap remain Senior Manager accountabilities. This role operationalizes that direction through assigned initiative delivery and implementation support.

Key Responsabilities:

  • Lead and deliver assigned CI and BPM initiatives by managing work from problem definition through implementation, and sustained adoption.

  • Define improvement scope by working with stakeholders to translate ambiguous or not-yet-fully defined problems into structured objectives, analysis plans, and delivery work.

  • Analyze processes and performance using operational data, stakeholder input, root cause analysis, and process evidence to identify gaps, risks, bottlenecks, rework, and improvement opportunities.

  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to validate findings, challenge assumptions, explore future-state options, and build alignment around practical solutions.

  • Design and document improved business processes using BPMN 2.0 and BPM practices to support decision-making, implementation, operational consistency, and ongoing process management.

  • Support People & Culture service delivery modernization by identifying opportunities to improve how People & Culture services are requested, delivered, and experienced by employees, applying user-centred methods such as journey mapping or personas where relevant.

  • Develop, operationalize, and monitor process performance measures for assigned initiatives, including KPIs related to volume, cycle time, quality, service levels, rework, and user-experience.

  • Apply foundational process architecture and value stream concepts to support assigned initiative analysis, end-to-end process understanding, and related deliverables.

  • Translate process needs into business requirements and system considerations by partnering with People Systems, business stakeholders, and technical SMEs, including Workday-related opportunities where applicable.

  • Deliver CI capability-building activities, including internally tailored White Belt, Yellow Belt, and other learning sessions, while contributing to improvements based on feedback and evolving organizational needs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Human Resources, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification, or equivalent practical continuous improvement experience.

  • 5 to 7 years of progressive, hands-on experience leading continuous improvement, business process management, business analysis, service improvement, or operational improvement within a complex organization.

  • Experience analyzing, designing, improving, and documenting end-to-end business processes using BPM practices and BPMN 2.0.

  • Experience using operational data and process performance measures to identify opportunities, support decisions, and track outcomes.

  • Experience managing initiatives through discovery, analysis, implementation, adoption, and performance monitoring.

  • Experience supporting CI, BPM, or process performance training and knowledge-transfer sessions.

Exposure to:

  • Business process architecture and process governance concepts, including process hierarchy, value streams, capabilities, handoffs, and process inventories.

  • Personas, journey mapping, service experience methods used to understand stakeholder needs and improve service delivery.

  • AI-enabled tools, process intelligence, process mining, or automation concepts used to support process analysis, documentation, insight generation, or improvement identification.

Assets:

  • Knowledge of Human Resources, People & Culture, Shared Services, or corporate service delivery.

  • Experience with HR technology or cloud-based enterprise platforms such as Workday.

  • Experience with business process modelling tools such as SAP Signavio.

  • Experience using AI-enabled process analysis, process mining, or automation tools to support business process improvement, or capability-building support.

  • PMP, CBAP, CBPA/CBPP, Prosci, or other relevant certification.

  • Experience supporting internally developed CI training programs or capability-building initiatives.

Language Requirements

  • Bilingualism in English and French is required.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Communicates clearly and persuasively with senior stakeholders, peers, and business partners, including audiences with limited knowledge of CI, BPM, service delivery, transformation, or project management.

  • Strong synthesis and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex process, data, system, and service delivery issues into clear findings, recommendations, and decision points.

  • Strong end-to-end process and systems thinking, with the ability to connect CI work across cross-functional handoffs, SaaS-enabled processes, and broader service delivery considerations.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to anticipate next steps, identify risks or dependencies, and advance assigned work forward while staying aligned to priorities.

  • Sound stakeholder judgment, including the ability to influence without formal authority, manage resistance, challenge constructively, and know when to push forward, adapt, or escalate.

title: Applied ML Engineer
description:
About Cozmo

Cozmo is the AI operating system for property claims. When a pipe bursts in someone's home at 2am, our agents answer the call, capture the loss, enter the claim into Xactimate and Cotality, dispatch the right contractor against SLA, chase acceptances before breach and draft the carrier-ready estimate from field photos. We run both halves of a claims operation: everything the customer touches and everything that happens behind the desk.

Our customers are restoration franchisors, TPAs and adjusting firms whose boards have told them to become AI-native and who have no way to do it themselves. Our anchor is one of the largest restoration franchisors in the US.

The role

Every claim we process generates hundreds of structured data points: line items, quantities, unit prices, room geometry, equipment counts, what was submitted and what the carrier approved. Years of this history sit in reports and carrier portals that nobody has ever built models on. Your job is to turn that raw sprawl into a data asset and ship the first models on top of it.

The pipeline is the hard part and the moat. Reports are messy, schemas drift across franchise locations, carrier responses arrive in half a dozen formats and the labels are negotiated outcomes rather than ground truth. The engineer who wins this role treats that mess as the job: builds ingestion that survives it, designs the schema the whole company will stand on and then trains the models, starting with gradient-boosted tabular systems predicting line-item approval outcomes and going wherever the data leads. Scope prediction from photos and transcripts, leakage detection and pricing intelligence are all open and unbuilt.

You own the whole path from raw export to a prediction serving a live claim. No handoffs, no research team upstream, no data team downstream. You are both.

You report to the CTO and work directly with both founders.

What you'll do

  • Build the claims data platform from scratch: ingestion, schema design, feature pipelines, storage and orchestration that a growing team inherits
  • Ship the first estimation models to production and iterate against live claim outcomes
  • Design the labeling and evaluation strategy for data where the label is a negotiated number, because getting the metric wrong here is worse than getting the model wrong
  • Wire model outputs into the agents running live claims, working with our forward deployed team during real go-lives
  • Build the tooling that lets a one/two-person ML effort move like ten: training pipelines, experiment tracking, serving, monitoring
  • Extend into the industry-first layer as the foundation solidifies: scope prediction from field photos and call transcripts, supplement and leakage detection

What we look for

  • 2 to 6 years shipping ML systems to production, with the pipeline scars to prove it
  • Excellent data engineering: Python, SQL, dbt or Spark or the equivalent, pipelines that survive schema drift and malformed real-world exports, comfort owning infrastructure end to end
  • Strong applied ML on tabular and structured data. You know when gradient boosting beats a neural network and you reach for the boring model that wins
  • Rigor about labels and leakage. You have caught a model that looked great in offline eval and was learning the wrong thing, and you can tell us exactly how
  • Bias for production over polish: you would rather have a live model improving weekly than a perfect one in a notebook
  • Evidence we can inspect: systems you built, data platforms you owned, open source, a writeup of a hard pipeline problem you solved
  • Excited to get close to the domain: reading estimates, sitting with adjusters, learning why a water mitigation claim prices the way it does

Nice to have

  • Structured extraction from documents, photos or call transcripts
  • Insurance, pricing, risk or marketplace data
  • LLM engineering for extraction and agent tool use

How we work

We work almost six days a week, in person in New York, and go-live weeks take the seventh day too. We say this plainly because intensity is our structural advantage against incumbents with a hundred times our headcount, and because the engineers we want read this section and relax. This is the environment where nobody tells you to slow down.

Compensation

Competitive salary for your market plus founding-level equity, weighted toward equity because the value of this role compounds with the data asset you build.

How to apply

No cover letter. Send three things to me:

  1. The best data pipeline or ML system you have shipped, with code or a writeup we can inspect
  2. A first-principles answer, under 60 seconds as a loom/Vimeo video, to: you have five years of claims history where every label is the approved value after negotiation between contractor and carrier. What goes wrong if you train on it directly, and what would you do instead?
  3. Which city you would work from and your soonest start date

We respond to every real application within 48 hours. An exceptional answer to question 2 gets an interview regardless of resume.

title: Quality Assurance Technician
description:
Aperia is unlocking a new era of efficiency and sustainability for commercial vehicle fleets, by developing innovative hardware and data analytics solutions. Inventors of the award- winning and disruptive Halotm Automatic Tire Inflator, and the cloud delivered Halo Connect tire analytics platform. Aperia saves fleets thousands of hours of down-time every week, reduces the carbon footprint and environmental impact of the freight industry. Join us as we expand our product offering and take the next steps on our journey toward bringing the "backbone of our economy" into the automation age.

We are unable to sponsor H-1B, F-1 OPT, and STEM OPT extension at this time.

Your Role

The Quality Assurance Technician is responsible for conducting product testing and monitoring, analyzing test results, performing failure analysis, and authoring to propagate the information within the company. You will play a crucial role in ensuring that our products meet the quality and reliability standards set by the company.

Your Responsibilities

  • Operate the On-going Reliability Testing (ORT) program.
    • Sample product from manufacturing and prepare it for testing on ORT equipment
    • Load/unload and operate ORT equipment.
    • Monitor testing results using software systems.
    • Perform Failure Analysis on products of interest. This can include mechanical, electrical and software systems.
    • Log product and testing information into spreadsheets and other tracking systems
  • Administer the Return Material Authorization (RMA) program
    • Physically receive in RMA products
    • Verify quantities and condition of RMA products
    • Record transactions in ERP software
    • Disposition product based on return condition and transact accordingly
    • Perform first level Failure Analysis of defect returned product
    • Summarize findings into reports and upload to designated databases
    • Escalate as needed for secondary engineering analysis
  • Maintain a clean working environment by maintaining the testing area, inventory of product and the FA laboratory
  • Adhere to all company safety and security rules and regulations to ensure a safe working environment for yourself and fellow co-workers.

Skills/Qualifications

  • 3+ years in high volume manufacturing, automotive preferred.
  • Previous QC/QC/Reliability/RMA experience is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of G-Suite and MS-Office products like spreadsheets, documents, data entry systems
  • Experience with Jira, SalesForce, ERP systems (SAP, NetSuite, etc) is a plus
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Having a high level of integrity and attention to detail are critical characteristics

Hourly Range: $30 - $35

This is a non-exempt position that requires routine lifting of up to 35 lbs. Occasional overtime may be required.

*Base salary only. Salary is dependent on multiple factors including, but not limited to, experience and location.

**Additional compensation may include equity, bonuses, stipends, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and long-term disability insurance.

title: Senior Product Manager, Marketing Agent
description:
About Us:
ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.
We support thousands of restaurants across North America, helping process $1B+ in gross food sales while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees. Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.
Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.
About the Position:

Most independent restaurants have no marketer, no agency, and no time. They have a diner list they've never used and a channel mix they've never optimized. Your job is to close that gap by doing their marketing for them and not by handing them one more thing to manage.

As Senior PM for the Marketing Agent domain, you'll own strategy and execution for how ChowNow markets on behalf of tens of thousands of restaurants. You'll take a product that today asks an owner to configure campaigns and evolve it into one that proposes them, runs them, and proves what they earned.

This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Product and will own the domain outright; No direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note: ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.
WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:
You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.
You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.
You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.
You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

What You'll Own:

  • Campaign creation and automation across email and SMS
  • The diner database and consent model. Restaurants own their diner relationships on ChowNow, and you own what makes them usable
  • The agentic layer that turns a restaurant's data into marketing action without adding work to their day
  • Marketing measurement. You'll set the company standard for incrementality and hold the org to it
  • Activation. A campaign tool nobody turns on is a tool that doesn't exist, so adoption is your problem, not a GTM handoff

    • You Should Apply If:

  • You have 5+ years of product management experience, including products you owned from problem definition through launch
  • You have hands-on experience with lifecycle or campaign products. Email, SMS, CRM, automation, or segmentation, in something you shipped and then operated
  • You have hands-on experience building with AI or agents. Shipped work rather than experiments
  • You have working fluency in SQL and product analytics. You pull and interpret your own data
  • You have experience owning metrics where attribution was contested, and defending a measurement approach to stakeholders

    • About Our Benefits:

  • Expected Base Salary: $158,00 - $200,000 (depending on candidate location and experience)
  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities.
  • A "Best Place to Work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience.
  • Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • Mental Health Coverage - we offer several programs to support your mental health and wellness goals.
  • Unlimited Paid Vacation. We expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life
  • 7 weeks of baby bonding time for all new parents (within the first year of birth or adoption), 8 Weeks of Paid Pregnancy Leave.
  • 401(k) Matching

  • Employee Stock Incentive Plan.
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly.

title: Director, IT M&A Integrations
description:
Come help build the future, where our work makes the world work!

SUMMARY

Green Infrastructure Partners Inc. has an opportunity for a Director, IT M&A Integrations position at our Head Office in Markham, ON.

This senior technology role will directly report to the Vice President, IT, and is responsible for planning, leading, and executing the end-to-end technology, software, and infrastructure integration of acquired companies, joint ventures, and carve-outs into the organization. This role serves as the primary IT integration lead across the deal lifecycle — from pre-close due diligence through Day 1 cutover, Transition Services Agreement (TSA) exit, and full post-merger integration. The Director partners closely with Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, HR, Security, and business unit leadership to ensure that every acquisition or divestiture is technically de-risked, operationally seamless for employees and customers, and structured to realize the technology-related synergies underpinning the deal thesis.

This position requires a seasoned, business-savvy technology executive who can operate with equal credibility in a boardroom and in a server room — someone with deep technical acumen, strong program and change leadership skills, and the emotional intelligence and resilience to guide people and organizations through the ambiguity, compressed timelines, and high stakes inherent to M&A activity.

PRIMARY SCOPE OF ROLE

IT DUE DILIGENCE

  • Lead pre-signing and pre-close IT due diligence on target companies, assessing application landscapes, infrastructure, cloud environments, network architecture, and vendor/software license portfolios.
  • Evaluate target company security posture, including identity and access management, data protection practices, vulnerability management, and regulatory/compliance exposure (e.g., PCI, GDPR, CCPA, SOX).
  • Quantify technical debt, shadow IT, end-of-life systems, and integration/disentanglement risks; translate findings into deal-relevant risk ratings, cost estimates, and go/no-go input for the deal team.
  • Identify software license transferability issues, contract change-of-control clauses, and third-party dependencies that could delay or complicate integration or separation.
  • Produce due diligence reports and executive summaries for the VP of IT, CIO, and deal leadership, clearly articulating risks, required investments, and integration complexity/cost.

DAY 1 READINESS

  • Design and execute the Day 1 IT readiness plan to ensure uninterrupted operations for employees and customers at the moment of legal close.
  • Own critical path workstreams including identity and access provisioning, email and collaboration tools, core network and connectivity, endpoint provisioning, and business-critical application access.
  • Coordinate cutover runbooks, rehearsals, and command-center support for close weekend/Day 1 execution, including contingency and rollback plans.
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, Facilities, and Security to ensure employees can badge in, log in, get paid, and serve customers without disruption on Day 1.
  • Establish a Day 1 issue triage and rapid-response process, with clear escalation paths to the VP of IT and executive stakeholders.

INTERGATION STRATEGY & EXECUTION

  • Design the target operating model (TOM) for IT, defining organizational structure, governance, and service delivery model for the combined entity.
  • Develop the application rationalization roadmap — assessing overlap, redundancy, and strategic fit across ERP, CRM, HR/payroll, and line-of-business systems, and defining consolidate/retire/retain decisions.
  • Build and drive execution of infrastructure migration plans, including data center, network, cloud, telephony, and end-user computing migrations.
  • Establish integration program governance: workstream charters, RAID logs, milestone tracking, and steering committee reporting cadence.
  • Lead cross-functional workstream leads and third-party integration partners/systems integrators to deliver against the integration master schedule.

TSA MANAGEMENT

  • Own the technology components of Transition Services Agreements (TSAs), ensuring services provided by or to the seller are scoped, resourced, and delivered per agreed terms.
  • Track TSA exit criteria and timelines, proactively managing dependencies to ensure timely separation and full exit from seller-owned or shared systems and infrastructure.
  • Negotiate TSA scope, cost, and extension requests in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development, escalating risks that threaten exit deadlines.
  • Manage vendor and service provider relationships required to stand up replacement capabilities ahead of TSA expiration.

SYNERGY & VALUE REALIZATION

  • Track integration milestones, spend, and benefits realization against the approved integration budget and the deal’s technology synergy case.
  • Manage the IT integration budget, including capital and operating spend, third-party/systems integrator costs, and contingency reserves.
  • Report progress, risks, and value realization to the VP of IT, CIO, and executive/steering committee stakeholders on a regular cadence.
  • Identify and execute cost-synergy opportunities (e.g., license consolidation, vendor renegotiation, infrastructure decommissioning) and technology-enabled value creation opportunities.
  • Conduct post-integration reviews (lessons learned) to continuously improve the organization’s M&A integration playbook, tools, and templates.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and single point of accountability for IT within the broader Corporate Development / M&A function, building strong, durable business relationships with deal and functional leaders.
  • Lead change management and communications for impacted employees, ensuring clarity, empathy, and consistency throughout periods of significant organizational change.
  • Embed cybersecurity, data privacy, and regulatory compliance requirements into every phase of the integration or separation.
  • Maintain and continuously refine the enterprise M&A IT integration playbook, standard workstream templates, and readiness checklists.
  • Support divestiture and carve-out activity in addition to acquisitions, including standing up standalone IT capability for separated entities.

EXPERIENCE

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in IT management, enterprise architecture, or IT operations, including several years focused specifically on M&A integration or carve-out/divestiture lifecycles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading IT due diligence, Day 1 cutover, TSA management, and post-close integration across multiple transactions.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-entity, or industrial/heavy asset environments preferred (e.g., construction, engineering, manufacturing, or other capital-intensive industries).
  • Track record of managing multi-million-dollar integration budgets and delivering measurable cost synergies and technology value.

LEADERSHIP

  • Proven ability to lead and coordinate cross-functional workstreams spanning IT, Security, HR, Finance, Legal, and business operations.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with demonstrated ability to engage and influence CIOs, CTOs, and other C-suite stakeholders, both internally and at acquired/target companies.
  • Experience building and leading high-performing, matrixed teams, including direct reports, dotted-line workstream leads, and third-party integration partners.
  • Comfortable operating under ambiguity, compressed timelines, and confidentiality constraints typical of active deal environments.

TECHNICAL ACUMEN

  • Strong background in enterprise middleware, integration platforms, and API-based system connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience leading cloud migrations (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Deep familiarity with ERP and CRM integration and rationalization (e.g., JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce).
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity compliance frameworks and their application to M&A risk assessment and remediation (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Controls).
  • Understanding of enterprise network, identity/access management (IAM), collaboration platforms, and end-user computing at a level sufficient to direct Day 1 readiness planning.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field required; MBA or relevant Master’s degree preferred.
  • Relevant industry certifications strongly preferred, such as:
    • Project Management Professional (PMP) or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
    • Certified Merger & Acquisition Advisor (CM&AA) or equivalent M&A/integration credential
    • ITIL v4 Foundation or higher, for IT service management best practices
    • TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification
    • CISSP, CISM, or CRISC for cybersecurity and risk governance credibility
    • Cloud architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert)
    • Prosci Change Management Certification or equivalent organizational change management credential
    • Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt) for process rationalization and continuous improvement

CORE COMPETENCIES

This role requires a seasoned leader who combines strong technical and program management capability with exceptional interpersonal skill. Given the sensitivity, pace, and human impact of M&A activity, the following competencies are essential to success:

  • Business Relationship Management: Builds and sustains trusted, credible relationships with executives, deal teams, and acquired-company leadership; balances the needs of multiple stakeholders while keeping the integration on track.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Reads organizational and individual dynamics accurately, especially amid the uncertainty and anxiety that accompany acquisitions; communicates with empathy, tact, and cultural sensitivity across newly combined teams.
  • Resilience & Composure: Maintains sound judgment and steady leadership under high pressure, tight deadlines, incomplete information, and shifting deal timelines; recovers quickly from setbacks and keeps teams focused.
  • Executive Presence & Influence: Communicates complex technical risk and integration status clearly and credibly to senior executives and boards; influences without direct authority across a matrixed, cross-functional environment.
  • Discretion & Judgment: Handles highly confidential, market-sensitive deal information with integrity and sound decision-making.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-changing environment with evolving scope, and adjusts integration approach based on deal size, complexity, and strategic intent.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Expected Base Salary: $160,000 - 180,000 per year. The actual base salary will depend on several factors including experience, qualifications, internal equity and work location.
  • Annual performance-based bonus.
  • Comprehensive group benefits program.
  • Retirement savings program.
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities.

Disclaimers

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Disclosure: AI tools are not used in the screening or assessment of applicants for this position.

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing job vacancy.

We believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences. title: Branch Operations Lead - Mosaic at Merrifield - Fairfax, VA
description:
At Chase, we are passionate about creating memorable experiences for our clients and employees, making them feel welcomed, valued, and understood. We build lasting relationships by doing the right thing, exceeding expectations, and embracing diversity and inclusion.

As a Branch Operations Lead in a Chase Branch, you'll be at the heart of our branch operations, working closely with the Branch Manager, branch employees, and our team of experts. Your role is crucial in ensuring that our clients' financial transactions are handled with precision and care, all while adhering to our policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

A typical day will involve assisting clients with their transactions, but it doesn't stop there. You'll have the opportunity to make a real difference by introducing clients to self-service options that simplify their banking experience and by building lasting relationships with them. Throughout the week, you'll also dedicate time to reviewing branch operations and keeping the branch team informed about the latest policies and procedures. Your leadership will ensure that our branch not only meets but exceeds control expectations, setting a positive tone for everyone who walks through our doors.

Job responsibilities
  • Collaborate with the Branch Manager to create a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere in the branch, ensuring every client enjoys an exceptional experience and feels part of a dynamic community.

title: ICITAP Forensic Digital Evidence Advisor
description:
Amentum is a premier global services partner supporting critical programs of national significance across defense, security, intelligence, energy, and environment. Amentum draws from a century-old heritage of operational excellence, mission focus, and successful execution underpinned by a strong culture of safety and ethics. Headquartered in Chantilly, VA., Amentum employs more than 50,000 people on all seven continents.

Amentum is supporting the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) in providing specialized training, advisory and mentoring services to host nations under the Criminal Division’s International Criminal Investigative Training and Assistance Program (ICITAP). https://www.justice.gov/criminal-icitap.

ICITAP is a cornerstone of America’s global strategy for combating transnational crime, terrorism, countering trafficking in persons, establishing rule of law and enhancing human rights in developing countries. Amentum is the contract service provider to the DOJ ICITAP and Overseas Prosecutorial Development, Assistance and Training (OPDAT) programs.

Please Note: This is an Independent Contractor position with Amentum, it should not be considered an employment relationship with Amentum.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Amentum, in partnership with the U.S. Department of Justice’s International Criminal Investigative Training Assistance Program (ICITAP), is seeking a qualified Forensic Digital Evidence Advisor. The Forensic Digital Evidence Advisor is a subject matter expert in mobile digital and computer evidentiary analysis. The advisor will mentor host country experts on training, techniques and procedures used in the collection, preservation, triage, examination, analysis, and court production of digital evidence. The advisor will train and mentor host-country experts on understanding operating systems and the variety of evidence that may be recovered from phones, computers and other digital evidence. The advisor will train and advise host country officials on the use, maintenance and testing of equipment tools used for the extraction and analysis as well as best practices for digital or computer evidence exploitation, analysis reports and chain of custody records management. The advisor may be required to conduct advanced training related to conducting security assessments and link analysis. The advisor will also work with various US officials from Departments of State (DoS) and Justice (DOJ). Duties may also include facilitating meetings; leading working groups; developing reports; reviewing policies; developing quality management systems; and conducting briefings.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Train and mentor host-country examiners on operating systems, digital forensics best practices, chain of custody management, and forensic report writing.
  • Advise partners on the procurement, testing, use, and maintenance of digital extraction and analysis tools.
  • Deliver specialized instruction in security assessments, link analysis, and digital evidence exploitation.
  • Lead working groups, facilitate bilateral meetings, and draft comprehensive technical reports and progress briefings for U.S. government stakeholders.
  • Assist host-country labs in developing quality management systems, reviewing standard operating procedures (SOPs), and aligning with international forensic standards.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of 5 years of related digital evidence examination experience;
  • Must have working level experience using a wide variety of extraction and analysis tools, other than Cellebrite. Examples include, but are not limited to, experience using the following: Detego, Magnet AXIOM, EnCase, and/or Autopsy
  • Experience training other forensic examiners and first responders;
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Clearable: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Public Trust Clearance.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Certification from a relevant body in the field of digital evidence;
  • Experience supervising or managing digital evidence activities;
  • Experience in QA/QC inspections and validation for forensic facilities or working in an ISO 17025 or 17020 accredited facility;
  • Experience training or advising foreign officials.

title: Product Designer
description:
About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced and systems-oriented Product Designer to join us as our first in-house designer. You will report to the Head of Product and play a foundational role in shaping how care is delivered, managed, and experienced across our platform.

Abby Care is redefining family caregiving with AI-powered products and support. In this role, you’ll design end-to-end experiences across web and mobile for a wide range of users: family caregivers, clinicians, and operators. You’ll tackle complex, real-world problems and help shape the product direction and roadmap.

This is a full-time hybrid opportunity based in San Francisco, CA.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end product design: You will take full ownership of the design lifecycle, from problem framing and user research to workflows, interaction design, high-fidelity UI, launch, and iteration. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and accountability while being supported by the product and engineering teams.

  • Design systems and workflows, not just screens: You will design durable, configurable systems that support complex, multi-step workflows across roles and surfaces. This includes information architecture, role-based permissions, states, statuses, lifecycles, and edge cases. You should optimize for clarity, scalability, and correctness over visual flourish.

  • Design for multiple users and contexts: You will design experiences for a diverse set of users: family caregivers (B2C), as well as clinicians and operators (B2B), across both mobile and web. You’ll work with the product and engineering teams to balance differing needs, mental models, and constraints while maintaining coherence across the platform.

  • Partner cross-functionally to solve real-world problems: You will work closely with product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance teams to ensure solutions work in practice. You’ll help translate technical, regulatory, and operational constraints into thoughtful design decisions.

  • Design AI-assisted and human-in-the-loop experiences: You will contribute to the design of AI-assisted workflows that guide, support, and augment users while maintaining trust, transparency, and appropriate guardrails.

What success looks like:

  • Build a durable design system and clear information architecture that empowers our product and engineering teams to build complex workflows quickly and correctly.

  • Delivered highly intuitive, cross-platform solutions that seamlessly support the distinct mental models and needs of family caregivers, clinicians, and operators within a single coherent platform.

  • Cross-functionally launch human-in-the-loop, AI-assisted features that safely augment users while navigating strict healthcare regulations.

The Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a product designer

  • Strong experience designing systems, workflows, and information architecture

  • Experience designing for multi-role, permissioned products

  • Experience across web and mobile

  • Comfort owning the full design process, including user research, synthesis, and iteration

  • Experience working in healthcare or other regulated, high-stakes industries is preferred

  • Experience at startups or on small, fast-moving teams is preferred

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work.

  • Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays.

  • Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered).

  • Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide up to 10 weeks of paid parental leave based on tenure, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows.

Our Values

  1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

  2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

  3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

  4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

  5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.

Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

title: GenAI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect, AGS Specialist Solutions Architects
description:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and comprehensive support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and GenerativeAI? Are you passionate about helping customers build solutions leveraging the state-of-the-art AI/ML/GenAI tools on Amazon Web Service (AWS)? Come join us!

At Amazon, we’ve been investing deeply in artificial intelligence for over 20 years, and many of the capabilities customers experience in our products are driven by machine learning. Amazon.com’s recommendations engine is driven by machine learning (ML), as are the paths that optimize robotic picking routes in our fulfillment centers. Our supply chain, forecasting, and capacity planning are also informed by ML algorithms. Alexa is fueled by Natural Language Understanding and Automated Speech Recognition deep learning; as is Prime Air, and the computer vision technology in our new retail experience, Amazon Go. We have thousands of engineers at Amazon committed to machine learning and deep learning, and it’s a big part of our heritage.

Within AWS, we’re focused on bringing that knowledge and capability to customers through layers of the AI stack: 1) API-driven Inference Services like Amazon Bedrock 2) Agentic AI including Agentic platforms, tool usage, evaluations, governance and cost management along with use of Agentic SDKs such as Strands and platforms such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 3) Frameworks and Infrastructure with tools like Pytorch and TensorFlow, 2) Machine Learning Platforms such as Amazon SageMaker for data scientists, and, k to quickly add intelligence to applications with simple API calls.

AWS is looking for a Machine Learning Solutions Architect (ML SA), who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for helping customers in the AMERICAS design solutions that leverage our ML services. As part of the team, you will work closely with ISV(Independent Software Vendors) to enable large-scale use cases, design ML pipelines, and drive the adoption of AWS for the AI/ML platforms. You will interact with other SAs in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AI/ML on AWS. Additionally, as the voice of the customer, you will work closely with the service teams, and submit product feature requests to drive the platform forward.

You must have deep technical experience working with technologies related to Generative AI, machine learning and/or deep learning. A strong mathematics and statistics background is preferred in addition to experience building complex machine learning models. You will be familiar with the ecosystem of software vendors in the GenAI space, and will leverage this knowledge to help AWS customers in their selection process.

If you are a qualified and accepted candidate, you may work out of any of the following cities: San Jose, Los Angeles, Denver, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Atlanta, Arlington.

Travel up to 50% across the USA may be possible.

Key job responsibilities
Working with customers’ development and data science teams to deeply understand their business and technical needs. After understanding their needs, you will design solutions that make the best use of the AWS cloud platform and AWS AI/ML Services including SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon AgentCore, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Quick, Amazon Personalize, and other AI/ML services.
- Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and the AI/ML Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment in the AMERICAS for Amazon SageMaker and related services that support GenAI use cases.
- Thought Leadership – Evangelize AWS ML services and share best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re:Invent, etc.
- Act as a technical liaison between customers and the AWS SageMaker or other service teams to provide customer driven product improvement feedback.
- Develop and support an AWS internal community of GenAI related subject matter experts in the AMERICAS.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Principal Robotics Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Engineering

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Help Build the Future of Caterpillar

At Caterpillar, technology always has a purpose, which is to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Through Cat Technology, we are solving problems by building the intelligence layer that connects machines, data, and people to make jobsites safer, more productive, and more sustainable. By combining deep domain expertise in physical systems with software, connectivity, autonomy, and AI, we deliver solutions that work in the real world—on real jobsites, at global scale.

You’ll build and deploy against one of the most unique data foundations - over 1.6 million connected assets generating real-world data daily. These data and platform capabilities are enabling the development of AI models, edge computing architectures, and software systems that scale across fleets, products, and industries. The result will be a new generation of machines that continuously learn, improve, and deliver performance at scale.

Role Definition
We build the autonomy stack that lets large off-road machines operate themselves on real customer sites — from perception through motion to control, with modern learning-based methods and a classical robotics foundations.

We are hiring high-quality robotics generalists: engineers who can work confidently across the full stack and go deep in at least one domain. You will own real components end-to-end — from idea and prototype through to production on hardware.


Responsibilities

  • Participating in the processes of test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of robotics software.
  • Design, build, and ship autonomy components across perception, planning, control, and learning.
  • Take work from prototype to production on real hardware.
  • Bring depth in your specialty while contributing broadly across the stack.
  • Work in small, outcome-owning pods staffed from our capability benches.

Skill Descriptors

  • Software Product Design/Architecture: Knowledge of software product design; ability to convert market requirements into the software product design.
  • Artificial Intelligence: Knowledge of the concepts, technologies and methodologies of artificial intelligence (AI); ability to develop, implement and/or apply artificial intelligence products and services in specific industry domain to achieve business goals.
  • Programming: Knowledge of relevant programming languages and tools; ability to test, write, design, debug, troubleshoot and maintain source codes and computer programs.

Top Candidates Will Have:

  • Strong robotics generalist — comfortable moving across the autonomy stack rather than staying in one narrow lane.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of: AI, motion planning, perception, controls, or SLAM.
  • C++ and Python, production-quality.
  • ROS (or similar) in real robotics systems.
  • Full-lifecycle product experience — ideally has taken robotics products from idea to production, not just research or prototypes.
  • Pragmatic, first-principles engineer who owns components end-to-end and collaborates across a fast-moving delivery team.
  • Excited to get out on site and see their own code operate on iron — real machines in the real world, not just in the lab.
  • Real-world / field robotics or autonomous vehicles (on- or off-road).
  • Learning-based control or perception, or foundation / VLA-style models.
  • Sim and on-vehicle deployment.
  • MLOps / training-infrastructure depth for the ML-leaning profile.

Additional Details:

  • This position requires the candidate to work full-time at the Irving, TX office (Dallas)
  • Domestic relocation assistance is available for this position.
  • Visa sponsorship is NOT available with this position.

$147,760.00 - $240,110.00

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

Job Summary:

Performs, assists, and completes Cardiac and Vascular Radiographic examinations. Performs active radiographic interventional procedures in the cardiovascular lab using a variety of complicated and sophisticated equipment. Operates equipment to produce digital images of designated body portions, as ordered by physicians. Positions and instructs patients for examinations and performs specialized studies.

Job Requirements:

Education and Work Experience:

  • Associate’s Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred

Facility Specific License/Certifications:

  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required

Essential Functions:

  • Operates diagnostic imaging equipment to produce contrast enhanced radiographs of heart and cardiovascular system (Angio cardiograms), during cardiac catheterization, to aid physician in diagnostic evaluation and treatment: positions and immobilizes patient on examining table, using head and shoulder braces and following specified protocols.

Enters technical factors determined by protocol such as amount and quality of radiation beam, and specified filming sequence, into computer. Raises and lowers examining table and manipulates and positions x-ray tube in response to instructions from physician. Starts automatic injection of contrast medium into blood vessels of patient. Activates fluoroscope and motion picture camera (cinefluorography) to produce images that assist physician in guiding catheter through cardiovascular system of patient.
  • Provides patients with procedure explanations in preparation for exams and provides clear discharge instructions. Observes gauges, recorder, and video screens of multichannel data analysis system that indicates blood pressure, cardiac output, and respiration, during imaging of cardiovascular system. Alerts physician to changes in patient responses.

title: Part-Time Technical Specialist II: College of Arts & Sciences Technical Services - UTK
description:
The Electronic Specialist II is a 75%, part-time position within the College of Arts and Sciences Technical Services department. This position provides technical support, maintenance, repair, calibration, and design services for complex research, medical, and teaching instrumentation supporting the Division of Biology, College of Veterinary Medicine, and Institute of Agriculture. This position works with a wide range of laboratory and technical equipment, including microscopy, chromatography, spectroscopy, centrifugation, water purification, patient-monitoring equipment, balances, biological safety cabinets, incubators, autoclaves, environmental chambers, and other electronic and electromechanical instrumentation. The role also maintains and calibrates microscopy equipment and analytical balances, designs prototypical instruments, retrofits or redesigns existing equipment, and installs, maintains, and programs emergency telephone data-dialing systems.

The position maintains, repairs, and calibrates complex microscopy equipment, including compound, stereo, fluorescence, inverted, and polarizing microscopes. Calibration responsibilities include optical and Köhler alignment, parfocality, phase-contrast calibration, parcentration, stage tracking, and fluorescence-beam alignment. The position also maintains and calibrates analytical balances to Class 1 standards.

In addition, the Electronic Specialist II designs unique prototypical instruments for teaching and research applications, retrofits or redesigns existing instrumentation requiring repurposing, and installs, maintains, and programs emergency telephone data-dialing systems. Successful performance requires knowledge of electronics theory, strong problem-solving skills, mechanical, electrical, and electronic aptitude, the ability to read and design electronic and mechanical drawings, effective communication skills, and the ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Repair and Technical support:

  • Provides technical support and repair for complex research, medical, and teaching instrumentation.

  • Supports equipment including microscopy, chromatography, spectroscopy, centrifugation, water purification, patient monitoring, balances and scales, laminar flow hoods, biological safety cabinets, CO2 incubators, ovens, furnaces, shakers, electronic pipettes, microtomes and cryostats, gel documentation systems, syringe pumps, peristaltic pumps, autoclaves, environmental-controlled chambers, electronic controllers, X-ray generators, bioreactors, pH meters, vortex mixers, and water baths.

  • Repairs clean hoods and biological safety cabinets.

Maintenance and Calibration:

  • Maintains, repairs, and calibrates complex Microscopy equipment to include compound, stereo, fluorescence, inverted, and polarizing microscopes.

  • Calibrations include optical alignment, Kohler alignment, parfocality, phase contrast cal. parcentraton, stage tracking, including fluorescence beam alignment.

  • Maintains and calibrates analytical balances to class 1 standards.

Design and installation:

  • Designs unique prototypical instruments that are utilized in various teaching and research fields.

  • Retrofit or redesign existing instrumentation in need of repurposing.

  • Installs, maintains, and programs emergency telephone data dialing systems.

Required Qualifications:

Education:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Vocational or technical training

Experience:

  • Two years of experience in electronic repair

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of electronics theory
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
  • Excellent mechanical, electrical, and electronic aptitude
  • Ability to read and design electronic and mechanical drawings.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without need now or in the future for sponsorship for employment-based visa status.

title: Sterile Processing Technician, Medical Center East, PRN
description:
Primary Location:

JHHS - Med Center East - UMC

Address:

3920 Dutchman Lane
Louisville, KY 40207


Shift:

Job Description Summary:

About UofL Health:
UofL Health is a fully integrated regional academic health system with five hospitals, four medical centers, nearly 200 physician practice locations, more than 700 providers, the Frazier Rehab Institute and Brown Cancer Center.
With more than 12,000 team members—physicians, surgeons, nurses, pharmacists and other highly skilled health care professionals—UofL Health is focused on one mission: delivering patient-centered care to each and every patient each and every day.

Job Description:

Position Summary and Purpose
The primary purpose of Sterile Processing is to assist in direct patient care by ensuring the OR staff has correct, fully functional, sterile instrumentation delivered in a timely manner consistent with the highest standards of customer service. Sterile Processing Department (SPD) Techs are asked to perform the four basic departmental functions (decontamination, prep and pack, sterilization, and dispatch) with efficiency, expertise, and accuracy. The SPD Tech will display resourcefulness, determination, courtesy, and professionalism while adhering to the standards and procedures associated with the preparation, sterilization, storage, and delivery of surgical instrumentation per Association for the Advancement of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI) Associates of perioperative Registered Nurses (AORN), and CDC guidelines.


Essential Functions:
• Answers telephone promptly and assist caller with obtaining items needed
• Assembles supplies and places into case carts for scheduled and non-scheduled procedures
• Makes rounds throughout the hospital to deliver sterile and non-sterile instrumentation, supplies and equipment, and to pick-up contaminated or credit instrumentation, supplies and equipment
• Delivers scheduled case carts to the Surgery Department
• Inventories and delivers back-up case carts to the Surgery Department and required areas
• Maintains responsibility for returned instrumentation and supplies (if applicable) that is unused, and the integrity of packaging has not been compromised
• Performs cleaning and decontamination duties, working quickly and safely and thoroughly addresses all instrumentation taking into account any unique cleaning demands
• Inspects, assembles, and packages all decontaminated reusable instruments and sets ensuring for cleanliness and functionality of all instrumentation
• Operates all processing equipment used within the department
• Performs sterilization and all associated monitoring activities
• Observes all safety and security procedures; Reports potential unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and materials properly
• Assists in keeping the department organized, neat, clean, and fully stocked while providing quality customer service to all customers, including co-workers


Other Functions:
• Performs duties in a safe manner, to prevent injury to self, patients, visitors or other hospital personnel
• Contributes to maintaining supplies and sterile items for use throughout the hospital; keeps department clean, neat, and well organized
• Prioritizes work and focuses on consistent throughput
• Performs dispatch duties
• Contributes to all official departmental business in a professional manner
• Displays behavior that is consistent with a thorough understanding of the SPD Mission, Vision, and Values
• Maintains compliance with all company policies, procedures and standards of conduct
• Complies with HIPAA privacy and security requirements to maintain confidentiality at all times
• Performs other duties as assigned

Additional Job Description:

Job Requirements
(Education, Experience, Licensure and Certification)
Education:
• High school diploma or GED/ equivalent (required)

Experience:
• One (1) year of previous experience in a healthcare setting in a clinical capacity (preferred)
• Previous experience in sterile processing (strongly preferred)
Certification:
• Nationally recognized certification for Sterile Processing required within 12 months of hire date (required)

Job Competency:
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities critical to this role:
• Effectively communicates with co-workers and all other hospital personnel
• Able to decontaminate all reusable instruments, sets, and utensils according to acceptable sterile processing standards
• Knowledgeable regarding biological monitoring
• Approaches others in a tactful manner; reacts well under pressure; treats others with respect regardless of their status or position
• Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, gathering relevant data while attending to essential details; checks work for accuracy and quality.
• Must be able to problem-solve
• Must have strong relationship building skills and the ability to make and use connections throughout UofL Health to complete projects and maintain strong partnerships with other departments
• Must have strong initiative and be able to gather and analyze information skillfully and be able to brainstorm alternative resources and directions
• Must be able to break down complex tasks into manageable parts in a systematic, detailed way and considers input from several sources
• Must have great flexibility and the ability to continually look for ways to make appropriate adjustments and changes
• Ability to use instrument washer/decontaminator; Sonic washer; Cart washer; Steam sterilizer, Hydrogen peroxide plasma sterilizer

Language Ability:
• Adequate conversational English is required to ensure the individual be able to take direction from management, understand how to complete job tasks, communicate adequately with patients and co-workers as necessary, understand and follow safety guidelines, and organizational policies
• Able to write routine reports and correspondence; able to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization
Reasoning Ability:
• Must have ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Must have the ability to interpret an extensive variety of instructions and deliver successful results
• Ability to identify and understand issues, problems, and opportunities; determines course of action; develops appropriate solutions
Computer Skills:
• Working knowledge of Windows and Microsoft Office programs
• Able to use instrument management system and One Source
• Must have the capacity to learn other relevant systems and databases, as needed

Additional Responsibilities:
• Demonstrates a commitment to service, organization values and professionalism through appropriate conduct and demeanor at all times
• Maintains confidentiality and protects sensitive data at all times
• Adheres to organizational and department specific safety standards and guidelines
• Works collaboratively and supports efforts of team members
• Demonstrates exceptional customer service and interacts effectively with physicians, patients, residents, visitors, staff and the broader health care community


UofL Health Core Expectation:
At UofL Health, we expect all our employees to live the values of honesty, integrity and compassion and demonstrate these values in their interactions with others and as they deliver excellent patient care by:
• Honoring and caring for the dignity of all persons in mind, body, and spirit
• Ensuring the highest quality of care for those we serve
• Working together as a team to achieve our goals
• Improving continuously by listening, and asking for and responding to feedback
• Seeking new and better ways to meet the needs of those we serve
• Using our resources wisely
• Understanding how each of our roles contributes to the success of UofL Health
